text:
jamal: quick q — where's the short cheat for finding p95 + 5xx by org+route+region? need to tune alerts for EU gen routes.

alex: try the latency dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/latency -> use saved view 'ops: p95 by route (region)'. for logs, use this LogSearch snippet:
```
org:acme AND route:gen* AND region:eu
| filter status >= 500 and status < 600
| stats pctl(latency_ms,95) as p95 by route
| timebucket(1m)
```

maria: if you want it as a saved search: run the query then click 'Save search' -> name it `EU gen p95 & 5xx - ops`. I can pin it to the ops nav.

shay: note — kv_cache_miss spikes look like false positives for p95. exclude them with `AND kv_cache_miss:false` if you're tuning alerts for real infra issues. Also watch for short-lived cold-start bursts.

maria: for alert tuning, current alert is p95 > 600ms for all gen routes. suggestion: make it route-specific: gen-xl -> 800ms, gen -> 650ms. also add a 5xx rate guard: alert only if 5xx_rate > 0.5% over 5m window.

jamal: perfect — can you open the alert PR? prefer route-level thresholds + a note about KV cache effects.

maria: yep, will do. created saved search and pinned for now.

ops-bot: Saved search 'EU gen p95 & 5xx - ops' created by maria at 1715350000 :thumbsup:

alex: ping @shay @maria when you open the PR and include the log query + the dashboard link.
